summary_en: A cooking show episode details the preparation of stir-fried snails with bitter bush leaves. The host and chef introduce ingredients, marinate the snails, prep glass noodles and leaves, and cook everything over a gas stove. The finished dish is beautifully plated and garnished before the program concludes with an interactive audience segment.
